ValidationRule.description: Prevents editing of cases once they have been submitted to a queue. Uses the Block_PostSubmit_Edit custom permission (NOT a profile check) so that only roles explicitly granted that permission can edit submitted cases. IPOP-4. ADR note: corrected from original $Profile.Name formula per Part-A item 1.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cases submitted to a queue cannot be edited. Please contact your supervisor if a correction is needed.
